# AgentContextKit

> AgentContextKit (ACKit) 0.5.4 is an offline-first deterministic toolkit for turning repositories into agent-ready working environments.

## Documentation

- [AgentContextKit](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/): Agent readiness and repository context toolkit for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and MCP-based coding agents. Offline-first, deterministic.
- [Getting Started](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/getting-started/): Install and initialize AgentContextKit.
- [CLI Reference](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/cli/): ACKit commands, options and exit behavior.
- [Readiness](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/readiness/): Explainable ACKit repository readiness scoring.
- [Optimize](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/optimize/): Instruction and context hygiene advisor.
- [Provider Profiles](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/profiles/): Provider-aware context profiles for coding agents.
- [Instruction Graph](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/instruction-graph/): Resolve nested agent instructions with provenance and precedence.
- [Rule Packs](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/rule-packs/): Declarative offline repository policy checks.
- [Workflows](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/workflows/): Staged ACKit workflow lifecycles with deterministic gates.
- [Intent](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/intent/): Committed intent documents with fingerprints.
- [Checkpoints](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/checkpoints/): Resumable checkpoints with verification-bound portable handoff.
- [Evidence](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/evidence/): Acceptance criteria linked to typed proof.
- [Verification](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/verification/): State-bound verification bundles and independent verdicts.
- [Status](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/status/): Canonical read-only task status with blockers and next actions.
- [Drift](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/drift/): Deterministic workflow drift detection.
- [Policy](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/policy/): Risk-tiered autonomy and review policy.
- [Roles](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/roles/): Portable data-only agent role contracts.
- [Skills](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/skills/): Open-standard agent skills management.
- [Managed Sync](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/sync/): Reconcile ACKit-owned managed assets after upgrades.
- [GitHub Action](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/github-action/): Run ACKit repository checks in GitHub Actions.
- [MCP](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/mcp/): Local Model Context Protocol integration for ACKit.
- [SDK](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/sdk/): Programmatic ACKit repository analysis.
- [Provider Surfaces](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/provider-surfaces/): Canonical provider-surface mapping with CLI, SDK, MCP, Action and VS Code parity.
- [Trust Flow](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/trust-flow/): Reproducible verification-bound trust flow from evidence to resume.
- [Dashboard](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/dashboard/): Local ACKit dashboard and live repository views.
- [Diagnostics](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/diagnostics/): ACKit environment and support diagnostics.
- [VS Code](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/vscode/): AgentContextKit VS Code extension.
- [Security](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/security/): ACKit offline-first threat model and redaction guarantees.
- [Benchmarks](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/benchmarks/): Deterministic ACKit performance benchmarks.
- [Migration](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/migration/): Upgrade AgentContextKit to the current release.
- [AGENTS.md Validator](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/agents-md-validator/): Validate AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instructions; find conflicts, duplicates and scope problems.
- [AI Agent Readiness](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/ai-agent-readiness/): Score any repository 0–100 for AI coding-agent readiness with explainable deductions.
- [Context Optimization](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/context-optimization/): Cut wasted agent context: duplicates, oversized files and low-value includes.
- [MCP Repository Tools](https://cynrath.github.io/agent-context-kit/mcp-repository-tools/): Expose repository context to coding agents over local MCP stdio — read-only.
